purpose: Test short-possession, dead-ball and ownership specialists trained only on the four non-held games.
training: Three HGB models, 180 iterations, 31 leaves, learning rate .06; short-spell inverse-duration weight capped at 8; sampled every .8s plus .4s in short live spells; mirrored teams.
selection: Highest mean spellF1 on fold1 with macroF1 >= baseline-.002. Confirm only selected candidate on fold2; adopt if both game spell means improve and aggregate macro >= baseline-.002.
limitation: Previously used external games; new-round confirmation, not untouched final test.
